name: claude-limit-guard
description: Watches Claude subscription usage limits; shows them in the status line, injects them into context, and gracefully saves/resumes work at a configurable threshold.

threshold.title: Usage threshold (%)
threshold.description: At or above this percentage the guard routine triggers (default 95).

warn_band.title: Warning band (%)
warn_band.description: At or above this percentage (but below the threshold) the status line turns amber (default 80).

watch.title: Watched limit windows
watch.description: Comma-separated limit windows to show/guard, e.g. five_hour,seven_day (default five_hour,seven_day).

locale.title: Status-line locale
locale.description: BCP-47 locale for weekday names, e.g. en-US, cs-CZ, de-DE, ja-JP (default en-US).

guard_action.title: Guard action at threshold
guard_action.description: What the AI should do when the threshold is reached. Leave empty for the built-in save-and-handoff routine.

time_format.title: Time format
time_format.description: Reset time format in the status line: system (follow OS, default), 12, or 24.

style.title: Status-line style
style.description: Glyph style for the status line: auto (detect terminal, default), emoji, or ascii (safe for legacy cmd/conhost).
